item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Something Catchy For Coffee

turns.text: Add something catchy to this latte pic for a square café post. You pick the words—short, warm, in English. Keep the coffee and leaf art visible, no logo or extra sales info.

item.tests: Tests autonomous caption writing and attractive photo typography when the user delegates the wording.

answer_sheet.Language, length, and mood: English; a short, warm, catchy line suitable for a café post.
answer_sheet.Picture and platform: Use cafe-latte.jpg for a square social café post; no specific platform.
answer_sheet.Size and exclusions: Free-tier image size is fine. No logo, prices, offers, or other sales information; keep the coffee and leaf art visible.

must_haves: The supplied top-down latte photograph remains the base of the square output.
A short, coherent English caption is visibly added to the picture, rather than supplied only in chat.
The caption has a warm coffee-related tone and is readable against the background.
The latte and its leaf-shaped foam art remain visible and unobscured by the lettering.
No logo, price, discount, or other sales information is added.
